title: MNBL generation request
description:
What the C# host accepts before any world is generated (worldbridge::identity::load_request; written by worldbridge --new-request). After acceptance the compiler samples no clock and no randomness. Identities: RequestId = sha256('mnbl.request-id/1 mnbl.canonical-json/1
' + canonical request); ConfigurationId = sha256('mnbl.configuration-id/1 mnbl.canonical-json/1
' + canonical request without campaignInstanceId and seedSource); SourceInputId (per attempt) = sha256('mnbl.source-input-id/1
producer-lock <lock sha256>
producer <binary sha256>
recipe <recipe sha256>
'); WorldContentId = sha256('mnbl.world-content-id/1
' + sorted lines '<prefix>/<path>	<size>	<sha256>
'). Canonical encoding: mnbl.canonical-json/1 = RFC 8785 (JCS): members sorted by UTF-16 code units, ECMAScript number formatting, minimal string escaping, no whitespace. The recipe given to the producer is the canonical {"overrides","recipe_version","seed"} object; its exact UTF-8 bytes are hashed.

campaignInstanceId.description: Separates campaign sessions; never part of SourceInputId or WorldContentId and never evidence of different geography.

seedSource.description: explicit: the player entered or replays a seed (same-seed replay is always permitted); random: Random World drew a fresh seed from the OS CSPRNG before acceptance.

masterSeed.description: Width of the pinned producer's request seed (FWGC++ request_json.cpp). Probed against the pinned binary by tools/Test-GenerationIdentity.ps1, which records worldgen/contracts/producer-seed-width.json; worldbridge --generate refuses (seed_width_unverified) unless that record names the locked producer sha256.

overrides.description: Producer controls by published name; 'seed' and 'recipe_version' are root fields of the recipe, not overrides. Integers must lie within plus or minus 2^53 (9007199254740992): RFC 8785 numbers are IEEE doubles, so a larger integer could not be canonicalized without changing it (refused out_of_range).

producerLockSha256.description: sha256 of worldgen/producer.lock.json bytes; a new generation refuses a different lock (producer_changed). Accepted campaigns load their frozen bundle instead.

policies.description: Accepted policy revisions: policy name -> sha256 of its file. worldbridge --generate requires product-policy, world-quality and source-compatibility and takes its quality gate, source contract and attempt limit only from these bound files.

maxAttempts.description: Explicit attempt ceiling; worldbridge --generate refuses (policy_violation) a value above the bound product policy's maxQualityAttempts (3).
